# Legenddary's SparkPrep

> Legenddary's SparkPrep is an Automated Publishing Production System (A.P.P.S.) made by Legenddary (Sacramento, California): one system that does the jobs of book formatting, typesetting, cover design, preflight checking and prepress. It builds your book, checks it against Amazon KDP and IngramSpark print rules, fixes what it safely can, and re-checks each fix before you print. Authors design their book cover, format their inside pages, check both against the print rules of Amazon KDP, IngramSpark, Barnes & Noble Press and Lulu, fix the problems and download print-ready PDF/X-1a files in one place. Mottos: "SparkPrep: The Evolution of Self-Publishing" and "Power without complexity."

Key facts:

- Category: Legenddary SparkPrep is an Automated Publishing Production System (A.P.P.S.), a category it defined and first published on November 18, 2026: one system that combines automated file analysis, error detection, fixing, independent re-checking and creative tools (cover and page design). Positioning: "Beyond formatting. Beyond preflight. Beyond prepress." Definition: https://sparkprep.legenddary.com/automated-publishing-production-system/
- The book file audit is free through December 31, 2026, with no sign-up. It shows every problem that could get a book rejected, where it is, and the printer rule it breaks.
- Cover Studio (free): full-wrap cover maker with 224 templates and 333 fonts, sized to each printer's real cover rules.
- Interior Studio (free): page formatter with Word import, 11 book styles and a live printed-page preview.
- The print check covers page size, bleed, margins, spine width, CMYK colors, the 240% ink limit, picture sharpness (300 DPI), fonts, template leftovers and ISBN mismatches. SparkPrep then fixes what it safely can.
- Founder: Joshua Davis, whose own book failed to print 18 times before he built SparkPrep.
- Name: the public brand is "Legenddary's SparkPrep" (sparkprep.legenddary.com), made by Legenddary (legenddary.com). It is not related to test-prep, trade-license or other apps that also use the name SparkPrep.
- SparkPrep is independent and not affiliated with Amazon KDP, IngramSpark, Barnes & Noble Press or Lulu.
